title: Paper Cut
line: Craft paper and cardboard, a deep teal, bouncy type and page peels: made by hand.
line_zh: 牛皮纸与瓦楞纸，一抹深青，弹跳字效与翻页转场：手作感。
prompt: Paper cut style: kraft paper ground with a cardboard tooth, dark brown ink and one deep teal, bouncy pop-in type, page-peel and swipe-up transitions, a light folk pluck bed with paper rustles, pops and a stamp.
prompt_zh: 剪纸拼贴风格：牛皮纸底加瓦楞纹理，深棕墨色与一抹深青，弹跳出现的字效，翻页与上滑转场，轻快的民谣拨弦配乐，配纸张沙沙声、弹出声与盖章声。
essence: Everything looks cut, stuck and lifted by hand: warm paper, honest texture and a little bounce. It is friendly, not childish.

not.difference: Editorial Print is a flat printed page with serif type; Paper Cut is layered craft paper with bouncy sans type.
Soft Clay is rounded 3D under studio light; Paper Cut is flat layers with paper texture.

palette.logic: a kraft ground, dark brown ink, ONE deep teal; colours read like coloured paper, never glossy

camera.expresses: a playful tilt of the paper
a quick lean on the cut-out word

sound.foley: paper rustles, flips, a card riffle and a stamp

signature_features.text: kraft ground with dark brown ink at 11:1 and a teal accent at 4:1 (contrast.py)
elastic pop-in type with a small overshoot
a folk pluck bed under paper sounds
the cardboard and paper tooth reads at phone size
